# core-project-and-scene-lifecycle-awplanet

Strictly dependent awplanet adapter child for the core project and scene lifecycle Direction Slice. Its serial dependency gate is satisfied only by accepted source A2 `871dfc9b80dcb9b375e0da6e400b4147a344cb67`, provenance B2 `ac2bee06bec899e74282678e7d05d948cc724c86`, and dependency-envelope SHA-256 `73efb9b4b99eca843e9bafba5b1114c64037232bdf622f56f223d3502b5da0c3`.

The Change is implementation-ready through `proposal.md`, `design.md`, five delta capability specs, and `tasks.md`. The accepted 0.2.0 contract mechanically requires ordered camera records and `maxCamerasPerScene: 64`; this does not claim Slice 2 completion and does not authorize Shot, Camera Path, Timeline, camera-specific UX, or new Preview semantics.
